title: Hunts FH-034: Qualify regional skate pilot

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 3, Pilot. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Confirm shop clusters, Poods option, accessibility, no-stunt policy, staffing, permits and bad-weather plan. Done when: Owner signs venue and city prerequisites before announcement. Player can complete through one accessible cluster. Requires: FH-033. Owner role: Local operations.
